identity.description: A nonempty identity with a 128-byte UTF-8 semantic ceiling; schema shape intentionally does not narrow the released Unicode character surface.

path_derived_identity.description: For fixture, harness, example, and internal-tool kinds, semantic validation requires exact identity == repository + # + path, a safeRelativePath-valid path suffix, and a 128-byte UTF-8 ceiling; Unicode, spaces, @, and + are valid suffix characters.

safe_path.description: A canonical repository-relative path. The exact released safeRelativePath algorithm and 4096-byte UTF-8 bound are mandatory semantic checks; Unicode, spaces, @, +, ..foo, ...foo, and a/..foo remain representable, while absolute paths, backslashes, exact dot segments, traversal, and noncanonical cleaned paths are rejected semantically.

root_or_relative_path.description: A canonical repository directory; exact dot denotes the repository root, otherwise the released safeRelativePath algorithm is mandatory.

planned_identity.$comment: Semantic validation requires repository-kind identity == repository; module/package/adapter identity follows the frozen rooted identity rules; fixture/harness/example/internal-tool identity equals repository#path byte-for-byte and its suffix passes the exact released safeRelativePath algorithm.

goal_sha256.description: Exact-byte SHA-256 of the goal file at source_revision; no field is omitted.
